components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action that matters on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent, #2f6fd1); color: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #2f6fd1); border-radius: 9px; padding: 6px 14px; font: 500 14px/1.4 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.14); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #2f6fd1 88%, black); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, #2f6fd1 32%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn { background: var(--surface, #fdfdfb); color: var(--ink, #191917); border: 1px solid var(--border, #e4e2da); border-radius: 9px; padding: 6px 14px; font: 500 14px/1.4 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #ebe9e3); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, #2f6fd1 32%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field

narrative.overview: Appa is a well-kept study notebook: warm paper, tidy pages, and a few bright tabs that tell you where things are. It is friendly, not childish: warmth lives in the small touches while the layout stays calm. Pages are softly lifted off the paper rather than drawn on it.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground, white pages one tone up, hairline rules.
One accent: Appa's sky blue, for the primary action, focus and new cards.
Data colours carry meaning (new, due, again, hard) and are never decoration.
Each class has a mark: its emoji, or its initial on a tint of its own hue.
Softly lifted panels; dialogs lifted most.
Themes swap the palette, never the structure.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: The accent marks the next action, focus and new cards. Nothing else on a screen is blue for decoration.

rules.name: The Data Colours Mean Something Rule
rules.body: Green is due, blue is new, red is again, amber is hard. They are never used as ornament.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Counts, dates and intervals use tabular figures so columns of numbers line up.

rules.name: The Sheets On A Desk Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces get a soft, low shadow, never a hard or dark one; the strongest shadow belongs to whatever is floating above the page.

dos: Do keep one blue: the primary action, focus and new cards.
Do give a class its emoji or tinted initial wherever classes are listed.
Do lift panels and cards softly off the paper; lift dialogs the most.
Do keep counts in the data colours and in tabular figures.
Do let warmth come from words, emoji and rounded corners, with calm layouts.
donts: Don't use the data colours (green, blue, red, amber) as decoration.
Don't add hard or dark shadows, or shadows on every element.
Don't change the structure between themes; themes only swap the palette.
Don't make it childish: no cartoon clutter, bouncing motion or loud colour during study.
